endorsements.label: Secret Scanning in Open Source at Scale (in-depth)
endorsements.description: We would be demonstrating the numbers and impact to an audience in this talk and we would also be providing ways to prevent this and automation to integrate in your own ci/cd pipelines to prevent such disasters from happening We would be presenting our research done on a large scale after in-house scanning on: This could pose a risk to anyone using those packages as dependencies or plugins so that this chain of not re-inventing the wheel could become a disaster that stops the wheel once and for all.
